result.summary: The bottom navigation has a clearly missing icon, and two horizontal carousels end with awkwardly clipped content at the right edge.

issues.description: The “Orders” item in the bottom navigation has no icon, leaving a conspicuous empty space above its label while every other tab has one.
issues.suggestion: Restore the Orders icon and align it consistently with the other navigation icons and labels.

issues.description: The category row shows only an unlabeled fragment of the next pill at the right edge, which looks accidentally cut off.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel spacing or the initial scroll position so the next category displays enough content to be recognizable, or hide the overflow cleanly.

issues.description: The third card in “Fastest near you” is heavily clipped, including its restaurant name and delivery text, creating an unfinished appearance.
issues.suggestion: Add appropriate right padding and card snapping so partially visible cards act as a clear carousel cue without clipping text awkwardly.
